bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日和 200 日均线，仍低于 $828–834

read.en: Micron jumped 11.9% on Nov 11 to $811.30, trading $763.05–827.58. It is above the 5-day ($723.2), 10-day ($791.9) and rising 200-day ($762.1) and below the 30-day ($909.5) and 100-day ($948.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($904.19), and RSI is 45.1.
read.zh: 美光 11月11日大涨 11.9%，收于 $811.30，盘中区间 $763.05–827.58。股价位于 5 日（$723.2）、10 日（$791.9）和上行的 200 日均线（$762.1）上方，30 日（$909.5）和 100 日均线（$948.2）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$904.19），RSI 为 45.1。

read.en: The rally cleared $737.9–745.6, the $760–762 zone (200-day, Nov 5 high) and the $782–795 Nov 4 low and close, now support; the $827.58 high stopped under the $829–834 Nov 2 low and close. Resistance is $827.6–833.6, then $845–855 (Nov 3 and Oct 22 lows, Nov 3 close) and $892–904 (Nov 2 high, SAR). Support is $782–795 (10-day), then $762 and $738–746. A close above $833.6 would target $845–855; below $782, $762.
